decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: One connected railway, not separate branches/opening stages. Reported permission, actual passenger opening, historical finance and a station-service advisory retain distinct evidence roles; no current concession or recurring outcome is admitted.

One municipality across its seven regions, not the wider city-region or a utility territory. Planned buses, event schedules, trials and the reported Dube handover retain their different stages and denominators.

One municipality, not Pretoria alone or seven separately counted regions. Six official indexed records/excerpts support bounded service descriptions; direct retrieval failures remain explicit. Pump restart, storage recovery, household service and digital maintenance are distinct.

review_checks: Seventeen selected official English source records inspected November 22 in America/Edmonton: eleven HTML bodies and six indexed-text records/excerpts. No new translated-reading identity or independent review is claimed.

All three named identities were screened against historical eligibility, Phase 119, Phase 191/192 and earlier additive accounts. No South Africa country docket or existing project/place identity is reused.
Eighteen substantive sections and fourteen chronology events are integrated. Each article has five source-bound sections and one labelled editorial evidence test.

Gautrain's June 2, 2010 permit handover is a report, not direct inspection of its instrument. The June 3 statement's anticipated June 7 service differs from the June 9 post-event account's June 8 maiden trip; the latter controls the actual opening date.
Bombela's July 2026 page-edit timestamp is not an original publication/opening date. The 2011 and 2012 stages complete one approximately 80-kilometre network, not extra projects.

DBSA's undated case study speaks from an earlier concession period and records a November 2016 preparation grant. Its financing structure, proposed coaches and earlier concession end reference do not establish November 2026 contract state or delivery.
The July 29 licensing-centre notice is a same-day advisory, not an observed opening. Road-licensing services at a station do not create more rail capacity.

Joburg's 2025 rollout, 2026 event plan and proposed electric-bus trial are distinct. No construction percentage is extrapolated, no R30 card price is described as the journey fare and no planned evaluation is called completed.

The City Power page says seven utility regions but lists eight names. Neither list nor count is used as municipality geography. Only its explicit City Power/direct Eskom responsibility distinction is used.
The October 30 Dube report supports 48 handed-over houses, not a separately known handover day, title inspection, citywide backlog outcome or sustained occupancy result.

Tshwane regional-office retrieval returned 502 twice and its public REST page endpoint was unavailable. Transport, digital-maintenance, exact pumping-restart and archive pages timed out; two exact November 21 notice attempts also timed out. November 3 power-failure retrieval returned 502. Six selected indexed official records are not relabelled as complete live-page inspections.
The November 4 restart record uses only the official daily archive excerpt. A third-party full repost was discovered but not used to fill the unavailable official body or its affected-area list.

The November 2 electrical incident, November 4 restart excerpt and November 21 reservoir conditions are not collapsed into one continuous outage. Restart is not full household restoration, and the later reservoir notice is not automatically attributed to Mapleton.

The November 6 digital notice reports a missed October target and a revised November 6–8 plan. No completion or current platform health is inferred, and no account, payment or reporting transaction was performed.

Bombela's About Gautrain page timed out twice, and Going Places exposed an unviewed video rather than substantive prose; neither is selected. Unused search-indexed PDFs, legal/tariff notices, population figures and third-party pages are not represented as inspected instruments.

All earlier cohorts, the 34 translated readings and the thirteen evidence-cycle identities remain intact. Local source integration does not authorize production cleanup, publication, launch or stewardship completion.
